name: python-complexity
description: Measure per-function cyclomatic (ruff C901) and cognitive (complexipy) complexity in Python with no project install, then count what they miss between functions: hops, pass-through layers, selector parameters. Use when asking which functions to refactor first, whether a function or call path is too complex or over-layered, when every function scores low but the code is hard to follow, when triaging a legacy codebase, or when verifying a refactor reduced rather than relocated complexity.
